results.title: The neuroscience of trust violation: Differential activation of the default mode network in ability, benevolence and integrity breaches
results.snippet: Using electroencephalogram with 68 participants, we identified the effects of three distinct types of trust violations—ability violation, integrity violation and benevolence violations—on electrical brain activity. Our findings indicate that trust violations are processed in social cognitive-related brain areas.
